title: scleria subulata
intro: Scleria subulata, commonly known as the Needle Sedge, is a type of plant that belongs to the Cyperaceae family. The health benefits of Scleria subulata include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestive health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can be used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Scleria subulata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
